design_rationale: The authors report a randomized sham-controlled trial with participants allocated using random sequence generation.

domain_judgments.rationale: Random sequence generation was used with allocation concealment via sealed envelopes, and baseline characteristics were comparable across groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants were randomized by random sequence generation 2:2:1:1 with allocation concealal by the envelope method as follows: active 1-Hz rTMS to the right DLPFC, active 10-Hz rTMS to the right DLPFC, sham 1-Hz rTMS to the right DLPFC, and sham 10 Hz to the right DLPFC.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blind design with an effective sham coil blinding participants, administered by an unblinded nurse not involved in outcome assessment, and analysed using intention-to-treat linear mixed models.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The sham condition involved either 1-Hz or 10-Hz sham stimulation with the above parameters by utilizing a sham Magstim D70 Air Film Coil model 3950-00, which was identical in appearance and produced a similar sound as the active coil as well as mimicked the vibratory somatosensory effect of active stimulation. The rTMS was administered solely by the clinic’s rTMS nurse (S.W.) who was unblinded to the protocol.

domain_judgments.rationale: Missing outcome data at the primary endpoint (treatment end) was minimal across groups and analyzed using intention-to-treat linear mixed models.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: To test primary and secondary outcomes, we utilized intention to treat data and linear mixed models with a group random effect. ... completers analyzed n=10 (1-Hz), n=9 (10-Hz), n=7 (Sham).

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome (CAPS-IV) was assessed by blinded raters using an established, standardized semistructured interview.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This semistructured instrument was administered by a blinded rater at baseline, at the conclusion of the blinded treatment phase, and at 3-month follow-up.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT01806168) and the primary and secondary outcomes and analyses align with the pre-specified plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We conducted a 2-week, double-blind (participants and raters) randomized sham-controlled study of rTMS in the treatment of PTSD (NCT01806168). ... The primary outcome of this study was a change in severity of PTSD symptoms at treatment end as assessed by the Clinician Administered PTSD Scale–IV (CAPS-IV).

overall_summary: The study is at low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains, with appropriate randomization and allocation concealment, adequate double-blinding using a sham coil, blinded outcome assessment, low attrition at the post-treatment endpoint, and pre-specified outcome reporting.

design_rationale: The study is a multicenter, double-blind randomized controlled trial where participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to active dTMS or sham using stratified block randomization via an interactive web-based system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation sequence was randomly generated by a statistician with random block sizes, concealed using a centralized web-based system, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study statistician generated the randomization allocation sequence using a stratified blocking method with a random block size (2, 4, 6, or 8 for each block). Participants were assigned to the intervention according to an interactive web-based randomization system. A single helmet contained both the active H7 and the sham coils... A coded magnetic card was assigned to each participant by the interactive web-based randomization system. The card activated the H7 or sham coil before each treatment.

domain_judgments.rationale: Patients and operators were effectively blinded using a sham coil in the same helmet activated by magnetic card, and analyses were reported on both per-protocol and intention-to-treat sets with consistent conclusions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The card activated the H7 or sham coil before each treatment. This ensured that both the operator and the patient remained blinded to the administered treatment... The per-protocol analysis set served for the efficacy assessment as predefined in the protocol. The efficacy analysis on the intention-to-treat dataset is provided as well.

domain_judgments.rationale: A notable proportion of randomized patients (34/125, ~27%) did not complete the primary endpoint at week 5, and the exact reasons and missing data handling in the ITT analysis are not fully detailed in the main text.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of 125 participants included in the interim safety analysis performed on January 17, 2020, 109 (per-protocol) participants without major protocol deviations were included in the main preplanned efficacy analysis, and 91 reached the primary end point at week 5 (Figure S1).

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome (CAPS-5) is an established validated clinical interview conducted by certified outcome raters who were independent and blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All efficacy outcome measures were performed by a blinded rater who was not permitted to attend the treatment sessions. Raters were required to pass a rater certification program developed to ensure adequate and reliable assessment and scoring skills.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was preregistered on ClinicalTrials.gov and reported pre-specified primary and secondary outcomes following a preplanned interim analysis rule.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was registered in ClinicalTrials.gov, the National Institutes of Health clinical trials registry (NCT02479906)... A preplanned interim analysis took place on January 17, 2020, to decide whether to continue the study as planned, increase the number of participants, or halt the study owing to clear success or failure to prove treatment efficacy.

overall_summary: The trial was generally well conducted with robust randomization, double-blinding, and blinded outcome assessments. However, some concerns arise due to missing outcome data, as over 25% of randomized participants did not reach the week 5 primary endpoint.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to either active rTMS treatment or sham rTMS.

domain_judgments.rationale: The authors state participants were randomly assigned, but provide no details on sequence generation or allocation concealment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Subjects were then randomly assigned to either active rTMS treatment or sham rTMS.

domain_judgments.rationale: Sham control was matched in appearance and sound, participants and outcome assessors were blinded, and all randomized subjects appear to have received their assigned interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients randomly assigned to receive sham treatments had their motor threshold elicited as above, but all subsequent treatments were given using a sham magnetic coil that looks and sounds identical to the active coil, but prevents magnetic energy from leaving the device.

domain_judgments.rationale: Data are presented for all 20 participants (10 per group) at post-treatment with no apparent dropouts or missing outcome data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Baseline and posttreatment scores on the standardized psychiatric scales (including CAPS, PCL, BDI, STAI, BNCE) are summarized in Table 1.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed using validated instruments administered by a blinded assessor, and self-report measures were collected under blinded sham-controlled conditions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All assessments were completed by research psychologist (B.L.) blinded to whether the patients were receiving active or sham treatments.

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no mention of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan to rule out selective reporting of outcomes and time points.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to lack of details regarding the random sequence generation and allocation concealment methods, as well as the absence of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified analysis plan.

design_rationale: The study is described as a double-blind trial in which 30 PTSD patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to three treatment groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although patients were described as randomly assigned and baseline characteristics were comparable across groups, the methods of sequence generation and allocation concealment are not reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In a double-blind study, 30 PTSD patients were enrolled and randomly assigned into 3 treatment groups: A) DTMS after brief exposure to the traumatic event... B) DTMS after brief exposure to a non-traumatic event; C) sham stimulation after brief exposure to the traumatic event.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial successfully implemented double-blinding with an active sham coil within the same helmet, and both per-protocol and intention-to-treat analyses yielded consistent results without apparent deviations from the assigned interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Placebo stimulation is performed with a sham coil placed in the same helmet encasing the active TMS coil. The sham coil produces a similar acoustic artifact and scalp sensation as the active coil... All symptoms scales and assessments were done by a blinded experienced rater or self-rated by the patients.

domain_judgments.rationale: Dropout rates were low and balanced across groups (one to two dropouts per group), reasons were reported, and results for the primary outcome were presented for the full intention-to-treat sample (N=30) as well as completers with similar results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Analysis of outcome measures took place on 26 patients who received at least 8 treatment sessions... Mean CAPS change during the treatment within each group and between group comparisons are shown in Tables 2 (Total-CAPS) and 3 (Intrusion-CAPS). Data are presented for the intention to treat patients (ITT, N = 30), treatment criterion (N = 26) and the completers (N = 25).

domain_judgments.rationale: Standard validated outcome measures were used and administered by an experienced assessor blinded to treatment allocation or completed via validated self-report instruments.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All symptoms scales and assessments were done by a blinded experienced rater or self-rated by the patients. The assessments included: the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale-II (CAPS, a widely used tool considered the gold standard in PTSD assessment [31])...

domain_judgments.rationale: While the trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, the primary analysis on Total-CAPS was not statistically significant on overall group-by-time interaction and conclusions focus heavily on subscale results (intrusive component) and within-group pre-planned contrasts without a clear pre-specified detailed statistical analysis plan provided.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was registered in the NIH clinical trials registry (NCT00517400)... Repeated measures ANOVA (performed for the baseline and 5th week data) on the CAPS of all groups did not indicate significant group*time interaction (P = 0.12), however, pre-planned comparisons showed the improvements in CAPS score to be significant only in the EXP-STIM group... For the intrusion component of the CAPS, group*time interaction was found significant...

overall_summary: The study has some concerns regarding the randomization process due to lack of detail on sequence generation and allocation concealment, as well as some concerns regarding the selection of the reported result given the focus on subscale findings and within-group contrast tests after non-significant overall interaction on the primary Total-CAPS measure. All other domains were assessed as low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1 design stratified by PTSD symptom severity and sex) to active iTBS or sham stimulation.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization was stratified and conducted by personnel uninvolved in treatment delivery, allocation concealment was maintained via an uninvolved staff member selecting coils, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants were randomized in a 1:1 design, stratified by PTSD symptom severity and sex. A study member uninvolved with TBS delivery performed randomization. Because the TMS system used separate coils for active and sham stimulation, a staff member uninvolved in treatment delivery or rating scale administration selected the coil for each participant.

domain_judgments.rationale: The acute 2-week trial was double-blind and sham-controlled with successful blinding confirmed, no substantial non-protocol deviations occurred, and analysis was conducted according to intent-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Using a modified parallel group, double blind, sham-controlled design... Blinding was assessed by asking participants to guess group assignment after the double-blind phase. Participants were unable to accurately guess group assignment (ChiSq=1.43, p=.49)... Data was analyzed in an intent-to-treat fashion, defined as participants that were randomized and received at least one iTBS session.

domain_judgments.rationale: Attrition during the blinded phase was very low (3 out of 50 randomized participants; 6%), balanced across groups, and appropriate statistical imputation methods were applied.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: High retention rates indicated acceptability; only three participants (2 sham, 1 active) withdrew during the double-blind phase (see Figure 1/CONSORT diagram... Missing data was addressed using multiple imputations (n=20 imputations, or maximum likelihood parameter estimation in mixed models).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessors were blinded to group assignment for clinician-rated scales, participant blinding was successful for self-report scales, and validated measurement tools were used across all participants.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blinded raters obtained all clinician-administered scales. Self-reported PTSD and depressive symptoms were measured using the PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL) and Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology Self-Report (IDSSR), respectively.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial was registered, the registry ID is blank in the text and an explicit pre-registered statistical analysis plan was not provided to fully rule out selective reporting among the multiple outcome scales and secondary mixed-model specifications.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier:... Primary clinical outcomes were measured using analysis of variance to compare groups at the end of the 2-week double blind phase.

overall_summary: The study was a well-conducted double-blind, sham-controlled randomized trial with low risk of bias across randomization, deviations, missing data, and measurement of outcomes. However, some concerns arise regarding the selection of reported results due to the omission of the trial registration identifier and detailed pre-specified statistical analysis protocol.

design_rationale: The authors describe the study as a prospective, randomized, double-blinded trial in which eight patients were randomly assigned using a simple randomization method to active or sham rTMS cells.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although simple randomization and sham-control smart cards were reported, the specific method of sequence generation and allocation concealment was not fully detailed, and substantial baseline imbalances exist in a very small sample (e.g., baseline HRSD24 score was 38 in control vs 15 in experimental).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After randomization (simple randomization method), each subject was assigned an initial smart card (active or sham).

domain_judgments.rationale: Blinding of participants and treater/raters was facilitated by preprogrammed smart cards and separate roles, with no reported protocol deviations affecting treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The device was the same TMS system used in the optimizing TMS for depression trial, but used a smart card system (preprogrammed credit card–sized plastic card imbedded with a flash memory chip) to control active versus sham stimulation delivery.

domain_judgments.rationale: Several prespecified secondary outcome measures (such as Beck Anxiety Inventory and PTSD Checklist) had incomplete data sets and were entirely excluded from reported results, indicating significant missingness without justification or sensitivity analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Data sets for the other secondary outcome measures were incomplete and, thus, not included here in results.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome measures were assessed with standardized clinical interview scales (e.g., CAPS, HRSD24) by raters distinct from the treaters and blinded to active versus sham status.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Trained treaters, who were not raters, delivered the treatment.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study explicitly omitted results for prespecified outcome measures due to incomplete data, without a pre-registered analysis plan, indicating selective reporting of outcomes.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Several secondary measures were administered weekly, to monitor mood and PTSD symptoms throughout treatment. These included the CAPS, Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression and Anxiety and the PTSD Checklist... Data sets for the other secondary outcome measures were incomplete and, thus, not included here in results.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is high due to substantial missing outcome data and selective outcome reporting, as several planned secondary symptom scales were omitted entirely from the results because of incomplete data sets.
